name: PROPHET
source:
Your village has chosen YOU for this pilgrimage, where you will ascend to Heaven representing them.

Near the end of your travels, you come upon the Great Prophet of the Church.  She will assist you on the ritual...

...but the Prophet may not be who she says she is.

[From [url=https://cattrigger.itch.io/prophet]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的村庄选择了你来参加这次朝圣，你将代表他们升入天堂。

在你的旅行即将结束时，你遇到了教会的伟大先知。她会协助你进行仪式……

……但先知可能不是她所说的那个人。

[来自[url=https://cattrigger.itch.io/prophet]itch.io[/url]]
